question: An Adult Swim adaptation of the original comic featured Dana Snyder providing the voice of its canine protagonist in 2016. The source appeared in KC Green’s Gunshow in 2013, under the title “On Fire”, before becoming a widely shared reaction image. Although the original strip contains six panels, the familiar meme usually circulates as only the opening pair of panels. For 10 points, give the three-word reassurance spoken by a dog sitting beside a coffee mug while flames engulf the room.

Antonio Guillem created the photograph behind this meme during a 2015 shoot in Girona, working with models on a theme of infidelity. The exaggerated poses made the models laugh during a planned stock-photo session, rather than capturing an unsuspecting couple on the street. Users attach labels to three people in the picture, turning a romantic triangle into a comparison between competing interests or priorities. For 10 points, name this meme showing a male pedestrian looking back at a passing woman while his visibly offended partner watches him.

Before becoming a meme, the man pictured in these images worked as a Hungarian electrical engineer specializing in lighting technology. A photographer discovered his holiday pictures online and recruited him for stock photographs, beginning an unexpected second career as a model. After initially feeling uncomfortable about the jokes, he embraced his internet fame and began connecting with fans through social media. For 10 points, name this white-haired stock-photo man whose strained smile seems to conceal distress, often pictured holding a coffee mug.

Aubrey Plaza supplied the voice of this internet celebrity in a Christmas television movie broadcast by Lifetime in 2014. This pet became a spokesperson for Friskies after online fame turned her face into a widely merchandised image. Photographs posted to Reddit in September 2012 introduced this Arizona pet, whose owner was Tabatha Bundesen, to a much larger audience. For 10 points, name this feline meme celebrity whose dwarfism and underbite contributed to an expression resembling a permanent, deeply displeased frown.

The Facebook page Special Meme Fresh posted an early version of this image in 2017, featuring a familiar computer-rendered head. Its central figure, Meme Man, wears a business suit in front of a board displaying financial market quotations. A large orange arrow rises behind the figure, providing a visual suggestion of financial success that often clashes with the caption. For 10 points, give this deliberately misspelled word for shares, used in memes that jokingly celebrate questionable investments and bad financial decisions.

Benjamin Aidoo leads the Ghanaian funeral-service team whose performances became the central footage of this internationally popular video meme. The team offers a choreographed alternative to a solemn procession, allowing families to choose a more celebratory farewell for the deceased. In viral edits, the electronic track “Astronomia” accompanies a cut away from somebody making a potentially disastrous and dangerous mistake. For 10 points, name this meme in which sharply dressed Ghanaian men move rhythmically while carrying a casket on their shoulders.

Phillip Banks introduced this drawing in a 2023 social-media post, before it gained a much wider audience through TikTok edits. Some popular edits pair the image with a speech from Dexter in which the protagonist describes his life after reinventing himself. The drawing wears a gray sweater, blue jeans and red shoes, with both hands tucked casually into its pockets. For 10 points, name this anthropomorphic brown dog meme whose slight smirk and relaxed posture express an attitude of being unbothered.

The title of this track came from the name of a pad sound on the Roland JP-8080 synthesizer used during production. Producer JS16 helped develop this Finnish artist’s breakthrough recording, which appeared on the debut album Before the Storm. Its music video follows a woman carrying a case as two pursuers chase her, while the artist watches with headphones on. For 10 points, identify this trance instrumental whose artist and title became a joking reply to virtually any online request to identify music.

An improvised lyric sung by ericdoa during a Twitch broadcast in January 2024 helped turn this haircut into a meme. The lyric imagines a particular look for a famous gamer, prompting fan edits showing how that streamer might appear with it. The streamer later repeatedly described the meme as “massive”, making his insistence on its continuing popularity another part of the joke. For 10 points, name this three-word hairstyle from the viral song line imagining Ninja with closely trimmed sides and more hair above.

Early TikTok uploads by this Arkansas creator featured NBA 2K gameplay in 2022, before his variety streams reached a larger audience. His gaming broadcasts have included horror titles such as Granny and Five Nights at Freddy’s, producing widely circulated reaction clips. He won the Content Creator of the Year category at The Game Awards in 2024 after building his audience on Twitch and TikTok. For 10 points, name this streamer whose exaggerated reactions to viewers’ roasts about his size became a recurring source of gaming memes.

A cosmetic charm bearing this creator’s name can be obtained by subscribing to his Twitch channel with a linked Ubisoft account. In March 2023, this streamer joined Spacestation Gaming as a content creator associated with the organization’s tactical-shooter audience. At the Streamer Awards ceremony held in February 2024, he received both Best Breakthrough Streamer and Gamer of the Year. For 10 points, name this Twitch creator especially associated with Rainbow Six Siege, the tactical shooter around which he built much of his gaming content and audience.

IShowSpeed helped popularize the question in reaction streams, directing it toward viewers when confronted with videos containing seemingly unbelievable material. The expression often accompanies obvious fabrications or AI-generated clips, turning a request for verification into an ironic reaction to absurdity. Its opening word treats the entire livestream audience as one collective addressee, addressing those watching the broadcast rather than naming any one individual commenter. For 10 points, give the four-word internet catchphrase asking an audience whether something surprising actually happened or whether the footage should be believed.

Geno Samuel made a long-form YouTube documentary series about this creator, tracing the history behind her extensive online presence. Her comic stories incorporate fictionalized versions of people from her life, placing personal experiences alongside characters borrowed from existing video-game franchises. Her comics and video blogs drew sustained attention from trolls after users of 4chan began sharing her work in 2007. For 10 points, name this internet personality who created Sonichu, a webcomic whose title character combines Sonic the Hedgehog with the Pokémon Pikachu.

Credited to Spalexma, this song reached streaming platforms in September 2025, before its later spread through short-form video memes. A widely shared artificial-intelligence video depicts JD Vance singing this track, presenting a fabricated musical performance before a large crowd. Some edits use this track as a bait-and-switch, interrupting apparently unrelated videos with its suddenly recognizable, dramatically sung refrain. For 10 points, identify this viral memorial song whose male vocalist declares solidarity with a slain American conservative activist and promises to “carry the flame”.
answer: We Are Charlie Kirk [prompt on Charlie Kirk by asking “Which song title?”]
